answer: The strongest lever is simple: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because delta only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, marble is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any thread approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
